mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% over the prior 3 months indicates a broad-based weakening in demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 0.5% and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply chain disruption regime (INDPRO < 100.0), manufacturing output contraction leads to higher inflation and reduced corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year) signals the Federal Reserve's imminent tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST > 700.0 thousand units) indicates robust consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 700.0 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A severe economic contraction regime (INDPRO < 100.0 and UNRATE > 5.0%) combines manufacturing output decline with labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to recessionary expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0 and UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained surge in consumer spending (RSAFS > 370,000 million dollars) signals strong economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings momentum accelerates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 370,000 million dollars.
